title: Base Station cannot reach SimpliSafe
fullDescription: Base Station tried to reach SimpliSafe via Wi-Fi or cellular and could not connect.

fixSteps.title: Reboot Base Station
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug for 30 seconds, remove batteries, reinsert and plug in.

whenToCallPro: If reboot does not resolve, contact SimpliSafe support.

title: Sensor battery low
shortDescription: A sensor needs a battery replacement.
fullDescription: SimpliSafe sensors use CR-123 or AA batteries that last 3-5 years.

fixSteps.title: Replace battery
fixSteps.instruction: Pop sensor off mount, open cover, swap battery.

title: Sensor removed from mount
fullDescription: Triggered when sensor is pulled from adhesive mount or cover opened.

fixSteps.title: Remount sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Replace adhesive pad, press firmly for 30 seconds.

title: Sensor not communicating with Base Station
shortDescription: Out of range or dead battery.
fullDescription: Base Station has not heard from sensor. Check batteries and position.

fixSteps.title: Move closer
fixSteps.instruction: Test by moving sensor near Base Station.

title: Base Station Wi-Fi lost
shortDescription: Base Station cannot connect to home Wi-Fi.

fixSteps.title: Reconnect Wi-Fi
fixSteps.instruction: Use SimpliSafe app > Base Station > Wi-Fi.

title: Keypad cannot find Base Station
fullDescription: Keypad displays no connection. Often battery or range issue.

title: Alarm without real intrusion
fullDescription: Check pets, drafts, and arming procedure.

fixSteps.title: Cancel via app
fixSteps.instruction: Disarm and contact SimpliSafe to cancel.

faq.a: Cities may fine repeated false alarms.

title: Delay expired without disarm
fullDescription: Increase entry delay or use app auto-disarm.

title: Base Station lost AC power
fullDescription: Base Station internal AA batteries kick in during outage (~24h).

title: SimpliCam or Doorbell offline
fullDescription: Check camera power, Wi-Fi, and firmware.
